1.

Now is the time of favour! Behold, now is the day of salvation! O sinner, seek your soul’s peace And take Jesus’ redemption.

2.

Now is the time of favour! Behold, Jesus invites you now! Tomorrow it may be too late, O, why dost thou delay?

3.

Now is the time of favour! A gracious "year of the Lord"; Shall He call thee in vain, And thou dost despise His grace?

4.

Now is the time of favour! Hear Jesus calls: Come! And Christ Himself proclaims to thee, That there is still room.
